fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/sitemap/SitemapUrlHealth.cy.js#Sitemap - HTTPS URL health TC-SM-01: Sitemap Pages — log status of page addresses listed in the XML
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SM-01
**Title:** Sitemap Pages — log status of page addresses listed in the XML

**Description:**
Read Sitemap Pages (/sitemap-pages.xml), count the page addresses it lists, then cy.request each https address. The next address is requested only after the previous response arrives, until the list is empty. This is a log-only check.

**Expected Result:**
The URL count and every page address status (200, 301, 404, 500, or other) are logged. The test always passes.

**Steps:**
1. Read page addresses from /sitemap-pages.xml
2. Log how many addresses that XML lists
3. Request each listed https address until none remain
4. Log 200, 301, 404, or 500 — do not fail the test
